h1: Custom Plastic Awards and Recognition Gifts
metaTitle: Custom Plastic Awards Recognition - Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom plastic awards recognition plaques and trophies for your team. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Plastic awards offer a lightweight, durable, and cost-effective way to recognize employee achievements, safety milestones, or years of service. Unlike glass or crystal, plastic resists breaking during shipping and handling, making it ideal for companies ordering in bulk for annual ceremonies or ongoing recognition programs. Choose from custom shapes, full-color imprinting, and a variety of finishes to match your company’s branding.
heroAltText: Custom plastic awards recognition plaques and trophies with company logo and engraving
